By [[533 BBY]],<ref name="Note" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Gravid]] and his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Gean]] owned a '''bastion''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]].<ref name="DP" />

==History==
Gravid came to believe that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] should merge [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|teachings]] with that of [[Sith training|their own]], and those attempts drove him increasingly mad.<ref name="DP" />

At some point around [[533 BBY]],<ref name="Note" /> Gravid&mdash;who had concluded that his repository of [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]] and tomes needed to be destroyed so that he could rebuild the organization&mdash;used the Force to raise [[Force barrier/Legends|barriers]] around his bastion and began eradicating the Sith knowledge in his possession, including all traces of the [[essence transfer]] ability.<ref name="DP" />

Gean broke through the shields around the bastion and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|confronted]] her Master in a [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|duel]]. During the fight, Gean was gravely injured after Gravid cleaved off one of her [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and shoulders as well as the left side of the Twi'lek's face and chest. However, Gean gained the upper hand, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Gravid despite being unarmed.<ref name="DP" />
